name: Tokumei Sousakan Mai ~Mi mo Kokoro mo Otosarete~
original_name: 特命捜査官 真衣 ～身も心も堕とされて ～
source:
In the near future...

Mai, an undercover investigator, is captured and confined by a crime group. The group decides to make her their spy and hires a professional trainer. From that day, a series of erotic lessons is given to her...

[From ErogeShop]
